title: Glass staff cards and View all folder
text: Tall live glass cards for each staff member on moving colored tiles, a glass folder as the last card of each section, and on/off and colors per section.

title: Glass widgets for the whole site
text: Your real pages with frosted, blurred glass panels, chromatic outlines and buttons as separate floating pieces. Choose the floating button color here.

title: Sample vial
text: A scroll story: tube, cap, label, sample, sealing and a new-test notification, on a live wall of moving cubes.

title: Report on your phone
text: A tilted lab report that forms out of falling dots as you scroll, with a warm orange-to-navy grain shadow. Blank sample report, no patient details.
